## Public records and attribution
The author profile links to the Malaysian Mensa Society National Committee, Malaysian patent MY197771A, Ministry of Health pharmacy innovation and quality records, a pharmacy research record, and official MyMediSAFE information. The Top 20 social entrepreneurship finalist distinction is attributed to the author's achievement record; a public finalist listing was not located during the latest update. Author-supplied Play Console exports record Warfarin Dosing HTK in 178 named country and territory markets; private app user totals are not disclosed.

## Author and book topics
Shahir Anuar Shahrani's documented profile covers pharmacy, medicine safety, medicine-device invention, healthcare applications, social entrepreneurship, Malaysian Mensa leadership, environmental medicine disposal, twice-exceptionality advocacy, Islamic storytelling, children's literature, independent publishing and strategic and social impact advice. MERCY is an illustrated Islamic story about Zayd and his father Khalid, faith, mistakes, sincere questions, learning differently, gratitude and compassion.

## Scope
This information is supplied by the author, not an independent review. Catalogue listings do not prove physical shop stock. Retailer availability and prices can change. The public reference page distinguishes verified edition identifiers from details awaiting a public catalogue match. These pages summarize the book; they do not reproduce its full text.
